description.tr: Tek çözümlü, her seferinde yeni üretilen sudokular: kolaydan uzmana tırman, not al, ipucu kullan ve saate karşı yarış.
description.en: Freshly generated sudokus with one solution each: climb from easy to expert, take notes, use hints and race the clock.

howTo.tr: Hücreye dokun, alttaki tuştan rakam seç; NOT ile kalem notu al. Klavye: oklar, 1-9, N not, H ipucu, Sil.
howTo.en: Tap a cell, then a digit on the pad; NOTES toggles pencil marks. Keyboard: arrows, 1-9, N notes, H hint, Delete.
